title: Torn Canvas of Horror
description: A young woman with dark messy hair in a blood-splattered white dress stands in the center, holding a large paintbrush dripping with red paint while clutching her chest. The canvas itself appears violently torn, revealing a surreal nightmare scene behind her containing floating skeletal remains, ghostly pale figures of children, and a lit candle on a wooden surface in the lower right.
prompt: A haunting surreal scene of a young woman with messy dark hair wearing a white dress covered in blood, standing inside a violently torn canvas. She holds a large dripping paintbrush in one hand and clutches her bloody chest with the other. Through the torn edges, a nightmare realm is visible with floating bones, ghostly children figures, and a single lit candle on a table. Dark blue and purple atmosphere with dramatic lighting, horror painting style.
